features: 【⌨️ 100-Key Wireless Keyboard】 Enjoy comfortable and efficient typing with the Acer SmartKeys X100 100-key keyboard, featuring silent keys and a practical layout for everyday work and productivity.

【🔗 Dual Connectivity – Bluetooth 5.2 & 2.4GHz】 Connect seamlessly through Bluetooth 5.2 or the 2.4GHz wireless receiver. Supports up to 3 devices simultaneously, including 2 Bluetooth devices and 1 receiver-connected device.

【🖥️ Digital Display & Multifunction Volume Knob】 Monitor battery level, connection channel, charging status and low-power alerts on the built-in digital screen. Rotate the multifunction knob to adjust volume or press it to mute.

【🔇 Silent Mouse with 3-Level DPI】 Work quietly with silent mouse clicks and choose between 800, 1200 and 1600 DPI settings for adjustable cursor sensitivity. The mouse supports both Bluetooth and 2.4GHz connectivity.

【🔋 Rechargeable Type-C Design】 Both keyboard and mouse feature Type-C charging. The keyboard offers up to 40 hours of continuous use, while the mouse provides approximately 25–60 days of battery life for daily office use, depending on usage.
